verdict.rationale: A corporate registry with an Online Filing Centre could plausibly offer bulk filing, such as batch annual returns for intermediaries managing many corporations, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents single-corporation transactions (incorporation, annual return, director changes), and the probe found no transactional API on the registry. The keyless open.canada.ca CKAN API is a separate national open-data layer, not a bulk-operation capability of this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
